en: A black-and-white postcard image showing a canal scene with historic European buildings lining both sides of the waterway. There is a bridge crossing the canal, and a person can be seen rowing a small boat in the water. The architecture is distinctively Flemish, with stepped gables and ornate façades. Swans or ducks are visible on the water. The text at the bottom identifies the location as Bruges and the bridge as 'Le Pont de la Paille' (The Straw Bridge).
